name: isOutboundMinimumTLSVersionSecure
definition: True when TLS is required for outbound mail and the lowest TLS version the email service accepts is 1.2 or higher. False when the minimum is below 1.2 or TLS is not required, because a minimum version only applies under a required-TLS policy.
population: the outbound mail the email service sends for one account; one account-level setting
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A successful read of the account's enforced TLS setting showing TLS required and a minimum version of at least 1.2; an error, 401/403, empty read or missing version is Not evaluated.
citations: SendGrid API reference, Enforced TLS settings (twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/api-reference/settings-enforced-tls): GET /v3/user/settings/enforced_tls returns require_tls, require_valid_cert and version

changeLog.change: Registered so the SendGrid email-security transformations can emit it. Meaning written from the public SendGrid API reference and one read of a real account (read-only); no replay-backed validation yet, so the key stays proposed and V0.

notes: The 1.2 bar follows RFC 8996. Read from SendGrid require_tls and version. Messaging Security is allowed too because the SendGrid integration is catalogued under communication (Messaging Security).
